title: Apple, MLB announce September “Friday Night Baseball” schedule
title_zh: 苹果、MLB公布9月“周五夜棒球”赛程

paragraphs.en: Apple and Major League Baseball unveiled the September schedule for “Friday Night Baseball,” along with the first-ever broadcasts live in Apple Immersive for Apple Vision Pro, which start August 28. Today, Apple and Major League Baseball (MLB) unveiled the September schedule for “Friday Night Baseball,” the weekly doubleheader streaming every Friday on Apple TV throughout the 2026 regular season. Apple TV subscribers across 60 countries and regions can enjoy two marquee matchups each week with enhanced production quality, expert commentary, and no local broadcast restrictions. For the first time, baseball fans can take in all the action of “Friday Night Baseball” live in Apple Immersive on Apple Vision Pro, leveraging 3D video recorded in 8K with a 180-degree field of view. On August 28, viewers with Vision Pro will experience the iconic Red Sox vs. Yankees rivalry from unique camera angles that place viewers right in the game, immersed in the drama of each at-bat, the celebrations in the dugout after a big hit, close plays at the outfield wall, and more. The experience features bespoke commentary from Paul Severino (play-by-play), Xavier Scruggs (analyst), and Michelle Margaux (sideline reporter); dedicated replays; and an immersive graphics package that includes team lineups and stats floating in the viewer’s space. During breaks in the action, the broadcast remains live, immersing viewers in the stadium experience from all angles as ambisonic microphones capture sounds in Spatial Audio. Apple Vision Pro users with an Apple TV subscription in Australia, Canada, Germany, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the UK, and the U.S. can stream the games live directly through the Apple TV app. Full game replays, as well as a highlight package of the game’s key moments, will be available on demand in the Apple TV app for Vision Pro. The schedule through the end of the “Friday Night Baseball” season includes weekly games live in Apple Immersive as teams begin their playoff push against division rivals. On September 4, the Cleveland Guardians look to keep their playoff hopes alive as they host the Detroit Tigers at Progressive Field. More intra-division matchups headline the schedule on September 11, as the first-place Milwaukee Brewers continue their run for a fourth consecutive division title against Elly De La Cruz and the Cincinnati Reds. paragraphs.zh: Apple 与美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）公布了“周五之夜棒球赛”的九月赛程，以及首个在 Apple Immersive 中通过 Apple Vision Pro 直播的赛事，直播将于 8 月 28 日开始。 今天，Apple 与美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）公布了“周五之夜棒球赛”的九月赛程。这项每周双场赛事将在 2026 年常规赛季期间于每周五在 Apple TV 上播出。 来自 60 个国家和地区的 Apple TV 订阅用户每周都能欣赏到两场备受瞩目的对决，享受更优质的制作效果、专业解说，且不受本地转播限制。 棒球球迷首次可以在 Apple Vision Pro 的 Apple Immersive 中实时观看“周五之夜棒球赛”的全部精彩瞬间，体验以 8K 分辨率录制、拥有 180 度视场的 3D 视频。 8 月 28 日，使用 Vision Pro 的观众将体验到标志性的红袜队对阵…… ……洋基队的经典对决，通过独特的摄像机角度让观众仿佛置身于比赛之中，沉浸式感受每一次击球的戏剧性瞬间、本垒打后休息区的庆祝场面、外野墙边的险象环生等精彩画面。 此次体验由 Paul Severino（实况解说）、Xavier Scruggs（分析员）和 Michelle Margaux（场边记者）提供专属解说，并包含专门的慢动作重播以及沉浸式图形界面，其中球队阵容和统计数据会悬浮在观众空间中。 比赛间歇期间，直播仍将继续，从各个角度让观众沉浸式体验球场氛围，同时环绕声麦克风通过空间音频捕捉现场声音。 在澳大利亚、加拿大、德国、香港、日本、韩国、台湾、英国和美国拥有 Apple TV 订阅的 Apple Vision Pro 用户，可以直接通过 Apple TV 应用观看比赛直播。 完整比赛的重播以及比赛关键时刻的精彩集锦，将在 Apple TV 应用中为 Vision Pro 用户提供点播服务。 “周五之夜棒球赛”赛季结束前的赛程中，每周都将有比赛在 Apple Immersive 中直播，届时各支球队将开始与同区对手展开季后赛冲刺。 9 月 4 日，克利夫兰守护者队将在进步球场主场迎战底特律老虎队，力争延续他们的季后赛希望。 更多同区对决将在 9 月 11 日的赛程中上演，届时排名榜首的密尔沃基酿酒人队将迎战埃利·德·拉·克鲁兹领衔的辛辛那提红人队，继续争夺队史第四个连续分区冠军。 与此同时，费尔南多·塔蒂斯·小……

paragraphs.en: and the surging San Diego Padres push for a National League wild card berth against the San Francisco Giants. On September 18, newly acquired Philadelphia Phillies infielder Luis Arráez furthers his pursuit of a fourth career batting title while teaming up with two-time MVP Bryce Harper as they look to help the Phillies gear up for a postseason run against the New York Mets. The “Friday Night Baseball” schedule concludes with one of baseball’s most storied rivalries taking center stage as four-time MVP Shohei Ohtani and the Los Angeles Dodgers host the San Francisco Giants, with the Dodgers looking to clinch their fifth consecutive division title. “Friday Night Baseball” games on Apple TV are called by broadcast teams Wayne Randazzo (play-by-play), Dontrelle Willis (analyst), and Heidi Watney (sideline reporter); and Alex Faust (play-by-play), Ryan Spilborghs (analyst), and Tricia Whitaker (sideline reporter). Game-by-game announcer assignments will be revealed weekly. The “Friday Night Baseball” pregame shows will be hosted by Siera Santos, former MLB All-Star Eric Hosmer, and insider Russell Dorsey. Fans in the U.S. and Canada will also have the option to listen to home and away local radio broadcasts during “Friday Night Baseball” games. 1 The weekly “Friday Night Baseball” doubleheader on Apple TV is produced by MLB Network’s Emmy Award-winning production team in partnership with Apple’s live sports production team, with the first game of each weekly doubleheader presented by Essilor. Apple TV Pricing and Availability Apple TV subscribers can watch “Friday Night Baseball” on the Apple TV app on iPhone; iPad; Apple TV 4K; Apple Vision Pro; Mac; popular smart TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO, TCL, and others; Roku and Amazon Fire TV devices; Chromecast with Google TV; PlayStation and Xbox gaming consoles; and at tv.apple.com , for $12.99 (U.S.) per month with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers. 2 For a limited time, eligible customers who purchase and activate a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, or Mac can enjoy three months of Apple TV for free. 3 Find out how to watch Apple TV and see the full list of supported devices . Apple Immersive Availability “Friday Night Baseball” in Apple Immersive will be available live on Apple Vision Pro (M5) and Vision Pro (M2) for users with an active Apple TV subscription. paragraphs.zh: 圣迭戈教士队正全力冲击国家联盟外卡席位，他们将迎战旧金山巨人队。 9月18日，新加入的费城费城人队内场手路易斯·阿拉埃斯将继续追逐其职业生涯第四个打击王头衔，同时与两度荣获MVP的布莱斯·哈珀联手，帮助费城人队为对阵纽约大都会队的季后赛做好准备。 “周五夜棒球”赛程将以一场棒球史上最负盛名的对决作为收官：四度荣获MVP的大谷翔平与洛杉矶道奇队将主场迎战旧金山巨人队，而道奇队则希望锁定他们连续第五个分区冠军。“周五夜棒球”在Apple TV上的比赛将由广播团队韦恩·兰达佐（实况解说）、唐特雷尔·威利斯（分析员）和海蒂·沃特尼（场边记者）负责解说；此外还有亚历克斯·福斯特（实况解说）、瑞安·斯皮尔博格斯（分析员）和特里西亚·惠特克（场边记者）。 每场比赛的解说人员安排将每周公布。 “周五夜棒球”的赛前节目将由西拉·桑托斯、前MLB全明星选手埃里克·霍斯默以及资深媒体人拉塞尔·多西主持。 美国和加拿大的球迷在观看“周五夜棒球”比赛时，也可以选择收听主队和客队当地的广播直播。1 每周在Apple TV上播出的“周五夜棒球”双赛制节目由MLB Network的艾美奖获奖制作团队与Apple的现场体育制作团队合作推出，每场双赛制的首场比赛由Essilor赞助呈现。 Apple TV价格与可用性：Apple TV订阅用户可通过Apple TV应用，在iPhone、iPad、Apple TV 4K、Apple Vision Pro、Mac、三星、LG、索尼、VIZIO、TCL等主流智能电视、Roku和Amazon Fire TV设备、Chromecast with Google TV、PlayStation和Xbox游戏主机以及tv.apple.com上观看“周五夜棒球”，每月费用为12.99美元（美国），新订阅用户可享七天免费试用。2 在限时活动期间，符合条件的顾客购买并激活新款iPhone、iPad、Apple TV或Mac后，可免费享用三个月的Apple TV服务。3 了解如何观看Apple TV以及查看完整支持设备列表。 Apple Immersive可用性：拥有有效Apple TV订阅的用户，可在Apple Vision Pro（M5）和Vision Pro（M2）上实时观看“周五夜棒球”的Apple Immersive版本。 分享文章 媒体 本文文本

sents.en: Yankees rivalry from unique camera angles that place viewers right in the game, immersed in the drama of each at-bat, the celebrations in the dugout after a big hit, close plays at the outfield wall, and more.

paragraphs.en: The experience features bespoke commentary from Paul Severino (play-by-play), Xavier Scruggs (analyst), and Michelle Margaux (sideline reporter); dedicated replays; and an immersive graphics package that includes team lineups and stats floating in the viewer’s space. During breaks in the action, the broadcast remains live, immersing viewers in the stadium experience from all angles as ambisonic microphones capture sounds in Spatial Audio.
paragraphs.zh: 本次体验包含 Paul Severino（实况解说）、Xavier Scruggs（分析员）和 Michelle Margaux（场边记者）的专属评论；专门的回放内容；以及沉浸式图形包，其中球队阵容和统计数据会悬浮在观众的视野空间中。 在比赛暂停期间，直播仍将继续，从各个角度让观众沉浸在体育场体验中，同时环绕声麦克风通过空间音频捕捉现场声音。

paragraphs.en: On September 4, the Cleveland Guardians look to keep their playoff hopes alive as they host the Detroit Tigers at Progressive Field. More intra-division matchups headline the schedule on September 11, as the first-place Milwaukee Brewers continue their run for a fourth consecutive division title against Elly De La Cruz and the Cincinnati Reds. Meanwhile, Fernando Tatís Jr. and the surging San Diego Padres push for a National League wild card berth against the San Francisco Giants.
paragraphs.zh: 9月4日，克利夫兰守护者队将在进步球场主场迎战底特律老虎队，力求延续他们的季后赛希望。 9月11日的赛程中，更多同分区对决将成为焦点，届时排名榜首的密尔沃基酿酒人队将对阵埃利·德·拉·克鲁兹和辛辛那提红人队，继续冲击队史第四个连续分区冠军。 与此同时，费尔南多·塔蒂斯·小将与势头正盛的圣迭戈教士队将对阵旧金山巨人队，争夺国家联盟外卡席位。

sents.en: On September 4, the Cleveland Guardians look to keep their playoff hopes alive as they host the Detroit Tigers at Progressive Field.
sents.zh: 9月4日，克利夫兰守护者队将在进步球场主场迎战底特律老虎队，力求延续他们的季后赛希望。

sents.en: More intra-division matchups headline the schedule on September 11, as the first-place Milwaukee Brewers continue their run for a fourth consecutive division title against Elly De La Cruz and the Cincinnati Reds.
sents.zh: 9月11日的赛程中，更多同分区对决将成为焦点，届时排名榜首的密尔沃基酿酒人队将对阵埃利·德·拉·克鲁兹和辛辛那提红人队，继续冲击队史第四个连续分区冠军。

sents.en: Meanwhile, Fernando Tatís Jr. and the surging San Diego Padres push for a National League wild card berth against the San Francisco Giants.
sents.zh: 与此同时，费尔南多·塔蒂斯·小将与势头正盛的圣迭戈教士队将对阵旧金山巨人队，争夺国家联盟外卡席位。

paragraphs.en: On September 18, newly acquired Philadelphia Phillies infielder Luis Arráez furthers his pursuit of a fourth career batting title while teaming up with two-time MVP Bryce Harper as they look to help the Phillies gear up for a postseason run against the New York Mets.
paragraphs.zh: 9月18日，新加入费城费城人队的内场手路易斯·阿拉埃斯继续追逐其职业生涯的第四个打击王头衔，同时与两度荣获MVP的布莱斯·哈珀联手，共同助力费城人队为对阵纽约大都会队的季后赛做好准备。

paragraphs.en: The “Friday Night Baseball” schedule concludes with one of baseball’s most storied rivalries taking center stage as four-time MVP Shohei Ohtani and the Los Angeles Dodgers host the San Francisco Giants, with the Dodgers looking to clinch their fifth consecutive division title.
paragraphs.zh: “周五夜棒球”赛程的收官之战将聚焦于棒球界最具传奇色彩的宿敌对决之一：四届MVP大谷翔平与洛杉矶道奇队将主场迎战旧金山巨人队，而道奇队则志在锁定他们连续第五个分区冠军。

paragraphs.en: “Friday Night Baseball” games on Apple TV are called by broadcast teams Wayne Randazzo (play-by-play), Dontrelle Willis (analyst), and Heidi Watney (sideline reporter); and Alex Faust (play-by-play), Ryan Spilborghs (analyst), and Tricia Whitaker (sideline reporter). Game-by-game announcer assignments will be revealed weekly. The “Friday Night Baseball” pregame shows will be hosted by Siera Santos, former MLB All-Star Eric Hosmer, and insider Russell Dorsey.
paragraphs.zh: Apple TV 上的《周五夜棒球》比赛由广播团队 Wayne Randazzo（实况解说）、Dontrelle Willis（分析员）和 Heidi Watney（场边记者）负责解说；另一组则由 Alex Faust（实况解说）、Ryan Spilborghs（分析员）和 Tricia Whitaker（场边记者）负责。 每场比赛的解说人员安排将每周公布。 《周五夜棒球》的赛前节目将由 Siera Santos、前 MLB 全明星球员 Eric Hosmer 以及内部消息人士 Russell Dorsey 主持。

sents.en: “Friday Night Baseball” games on Apple TV are called by broadcast teams Wayne Randazzo (play-by-play), Dontrelle Willis (analyst), and Heidi Watney (sideline reporter); and Alex Faust (play-by-play), Ryan Spilborghs (analyst), and Tricia Whitaker (sideline reporter).
sents.zh: Apple TV 上的《周五夜棒球》比赛由广播团队 Wayne Randazzo（实况解说）、Dontrelle Willis（分析员）和 Heidi Watney（场边记者）负责解说；另一组则由 Alex Faust（实况解说）、Ryan Spilborghs（分析员）和 Tricia Whitaker（场边记者）负责。

sents.en: Game-by-game announcer assignments will be revealed weekly.
sents.zh: 每场比赛的解说人员安排将每周公布。

paragraphs.en: Fans in the U.S. and Canada will also have the option to listen to home and away local radio broadcasts during “Friday Night Baseball” games. 1
paragraphs.zh: 美国和加拿大的球迷在“周五之夜棒球赛”比赛中，也将可以选择收听主队和客队的主场及客场本地广播。1

paragraphs.en: The weekly “Friday Night Baseball” doubleheader on Apple TV is produced by MLB Network’s Emmy Award-winning production team in partnership with Apple’s live sports production team, with the first game of each weekly doubleheader presented by Essilor.
paragraphs.zh: Apple TV 上每周播出的“周五之夜棒球赛”双场赛事，由 MLB Network 的艾美奖获奖制作团队与 Apple 的现场体育赛事制作团队合作制作，每场双赛的首场比赛由 Essilor 冠名呈现。

paragraphs.en: Apple TV subscribers can watch “Friday Night Baseball” on the Apple TV app on iPhone; iPad; Apple TV 4K; Apple Vision Pro; Mac; popular smart TVs from Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO, TCL, and others; Roku and Amazon Fire TV devices; Chromecast with Google TV; PlayStation and Xbox gaming consoles; and at tv.apple.com , for $12.99 (U.S.) per month with a seven-day free trial for new subscribers. 2 For a limited time, eligible customers who purchase and activate a new iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, or Mac can enjoy three months of Apple TV for free. 3 Find out how to watch Apple TV and see the full list of supported devices .
paragraphs.zh: Apple TV 订阅用户可以在 iPhone、iPad、Apple TV 4K、Apple Vision Pro、Mac，以及三星、LG、索尼、VIZIO、TCL 等品牌的热门智能电视、Roku 和亚马逊 Fire TV 设备、搭载 Google TV 的 Chromecast、PlayStation 和 Xbox 游戏机上观看《周五晚间棒球》；也可在 tv.apple.com 上观看。订阅费用为每月 12.99 美元（美国），新订阅用户可享七天免费试用。2 在限时活动期间，符合条件的客户购买并激活新款 iPhone、iPad、Apple TV 或 Mac 后，可免费享用三个月的 Apple TV 服务。3 了解如何观看 Apple TV 以及查看所有支持的设备列表。

paragraphs.en: “Friday Night Baseball” in Apple Immersive will be available live on Apple Vision Pro (M5) and Vision Pro (M2) for users with an active Apple TV subscription.
paragraphs.zh: Apple Immersive 中的《周五之夜棒球》将面向拥有有效 Apple TV 订阅的用户，在 Apple Vision Pro (M5) 和 Vision Pro (M2) 上提供直播。
